output.review_comment: The PR contains logic that exists only to satisfy a particular test (test_upload_limit_label) and contradicts the documented behavior in the docstring. The special-case rounding for values < 10 (lines 36-39) was added solely to pass one test, but creates a contradiction with the documented "round-half-up" behavior. Before merging, clarify the true specification with the storage team and update the docstring to match the implementation, or correct the implementation to match the documented spec.
